<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/render/api-key"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Submit a video rendering job. The job will be queued and processed asynchronously.

Credits will be reserved based on video resolution and duration:
- Resolution affects the computational cost
- Duration directly multiplies the base cost

Make sure you have sufficient credits before submitting.
